snippet.title: Dicebloom — Official Trailer | Cozy Dice Roguelite
snippet.description:
One roll sends a wave of bloom across the garden. Dicebloom is a cozy dice roguelite with a very uncozy appetite for multipliers.
▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5391740/Dicebloom/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer
▶ Discord: https://discord.gg/BVq3Gxvejn

Every morning you roll a die. The face it shows wakes the plants that carry it, and every plant that wakes can wake its neighbours — bees fly, seeds sprout, luck sparks and the multipliers climb. Grow a garden engine from 100 plants and 85 items, bargain with the Crow, survive boss weeks and pay a debt that rises every week.

Coming to Steam: Windows, macOS, Linux and Steam Deck.
#Dicebloom #roguelite #indiegame
